scope: Resolved APK runtime dependencies; build and test tools are separately pinned and verified by Gradle.
maintenance: Review stable updates within the frozen Kotlin/AGP/Compose families; regenerate locks and verification from official repositories and rerun affected native gates.
platforms: Android 11 and later; phone and tablet share one Compose application.
exit_strategy: Remove Android UI dependencies with the app adapter; the generated AssetLink contracts and server data have no Android dependency.
